title: 5.4 How Many? and Some
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals and prices, and order politely at a café and a market in Spanish.
goal: Ask how many with ¿Cuántos/Cuántas…hay? and say some with un poco de.
grammar_function: ¿Cuántos/Cuántas + noun + hay? Hay + number + noun; Hay un poco de + food.
speaking_outcome: Ask how many with ¿Cuántos/Cuántas…hay? and say some with un poco de.
